scenes.name: 渡口栈桥
scenes.summary: 开场与收尾的门面景：一条探进雾里的旧木栈桥，岸端连着土坡，水端消失在白雾里。它承担「进入故事」和「离开故事」两个仪式性时刻，构图要有明确的纵深引导——栈桥就是一条通往未知的走廊。

anchors.name: 断裂的第七块桥板
anchors.desc: 从岸边数第七块桥板断了一角，用麻绳捆着一截圆木补上

anchors.name: 系缆石桩
anchors.desc: 岸端一只矮石桩，缆绳勒出深槽，顶面被磨得发亮

anchors.name: 挑灯木杆
anchors.desc: 栈桥中段一根歪斜的木杆，铁钩上挂一盏熄着的纸灯笼

lighting.prompt: thick white fog swallowing the far end of the pier, flat shadowless light, wet plank surfaces with faint sheen, cold desaturated palette

image.prompt: An old wooden ferry pier reaching into dense white fog, Republican-era southern China riverside, broken seventh plank patched with a rope-bound log, worn mooring stone, tilted lantern pole with an unlit paper lantern, wet planks, empty scene with no people
image.negativePrompt: people, human figures, characters, crowds, silhouettes of people, plastic CG look, oversaturated colours, sterile showroom cleanliness, warped perspective, melted geometry, floating objects, text, watermark, signature
image.sheet: Environment reference sheet on ONE 16:9 landscape canvas, panels separated by thin hairline rules. MAIN ZONE, top-left, about 72% of the canvas width and 70% of its height: the master establishing view: low wide shot from the bank end of the old wooden ferry pier, planks leading straight into white fog, tilted lantern pole midway — the canonical look of this location. RIGHT COLUMN, full height along the right edge, stacked small panels: close-up detail studies of the rope-bound log patching the broken seventh plank and the unlit paper lantern on its iron hook. BOTTOM ROW, spanning beneath the main zone: close-up detail studies of the grooved mooring stone worn shiny on top, wet plank surfaces with faint sheen, rope fibres and knots on the mooring line. Every detail panel is a close-up crop of the SAME space shown in the master view — same geometry, same materials, same wear marks; nothing invented that is not present in the master view. Absolutely no people anywhere on the sheet. Weathered, lived-in materials: chipped paint, water stains, patina on metal, worn wood grain, dust in corners and light shafts; fabric and paper props show creases and age; nothing looks factory-new. Atmospheric depth with haze or volumetric light where the space allows

props.name: 旧皮箱
props.summary: 全剧最强的悬念道具：沈知微从第 1 集抱到第 6 集，谁碰翻谁的脸。观众要在六集里反复看到它的每个细节，最后开箱那一刻它就是主角——一致性崩了整部剧的底牌就穿帮。

anchors.name: 绿锈铜扣
anchors.desc: 两只方形铜搭扣，绿锈从缝里渗出来，右边那只有一道新划痕

anchors.name: 磨白的边角
anchors.desc: 四个包角的牛皮磨得发白起毛，右下角最重

anchors.name: 提手缠布
anchors.desc: 皮质提手断过，用靛蓝土布缠了两圈，布头塞在内侧
